scoring_justification: Kurtosis of per-atom strain distribution is recomputed from the submitted raw strain list; CSV trends are structural (monotonic, threshold) because full MD re-run is infeasible in lightweight checker.

hidden_assets.purpose: hidden reference CSV values for trends, derived from paper Fig.8 and insert of Fig.9; used only for direction validation, not absolute match
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper figures: Fig.8 (Sq_Gr, E_ad) and Fig.9 insert (epsilon_mean_top10); values extrapolated for Sq_Fe=2,4,6 Å
hidden_assets.generation_method: digitized from paper graphs and verified consistency with solve.sh reference
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: values are based on paper-reported data points

outputs.description: Aggregate statistics for three substrate conditions. Structural audit checks monotonic trends (Sq_Gr increases with Sq_Fe, E_ad decreases, epsilon_mean_top10 increases) and a numeric bound (epsilon_mean_top10 < 0.02 for Sq_Fe=2 Å).
Per-atom strain list for the Sq_Fe=6 Å condition. Structural audit computes kurtosis of the distribution and verifies it is > 3.

output_contract.notes: The verification checks structural properties (monotonic trends, threshold, distribution kurtosis) without requiring re-simulation. No hidden gold values are exposed in the public contract.
